power_graph_obstruction.result: An induced C4 in a power graph yields an induced P4: orient cyclic-subgroup containments alternately. For incomparable upper cyclic groups B,D with incomparable lower cyclic groups A,C, choose a prime-power cyclic subgroup E of B not in D. At least one lower group, say C, has order divisible by a different prime (otherwise A,C comparable). E,C are incomparable and E,D incomparable; generators e,b,c,d induce P4.
